source_audits.subject: G1 VMThread SATB queue creation, activation and partial-buffer remark drain
source_facts: Thread::Thread invokes BarrierSet::on_thread_create after barrier-set initialization; G1BarrierSet::on_thread_create allocates G1ThreadLocalData for all Thread objects.
VMThread derives from NamedThread, which derives from NonJavaThread. Thread::call_run invokes NonJavaThread::pre_run before VMThread::run, registering the VMThread in NonJavaThread::Iterator.
SATBMarkQueueSet::set_active_all_threads updates each queue through Threads::threads_do, whose non-Java iteration includes the registered VMThread.

G1RemarkThreadsClosure::do_thread flushes the SATB queue before any JavaThread-only work. Java 17 remark calls Threads::threads_do; Java 21/27 remark calls Threads::possibly_parallel_threads_do, which includes NonJavaThread::Iterator.

Therefore even a partial VMThread SATB buffer, including a single mirror newly published by a VM operation, is transferred for completed-buffer marking at remark. Full-buffer overflow is not required.
limitations: This exact tagged-source chain proves VMThread support; ordinary System.gc tests alone do not demonstrate an active concurrent marking phase.
The general heap iterator must independently prove object liveness around post-remark cleanup; CLDG lookup uses the matching internal live-holder traversal.
